items.title: FPIs withdraw ₹48,056 crore from equities in Oct amid elevated oil prices
items.description: However, Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) significantly moderated their selling last week and turned net buyers on two trading days, signalling some easing in selling pressure

items.title: Bond yields rise nearly 30 bps in Oct, to raise govt's interest burden
items.description: Yield on the 10-year benchmark government bond rose to 7.474 per cent on October 23 from 7.193 per cent on October 6, increasing about 28 basis points

items.title: Top 10 firms lose ₹1.55  trillion in mcap as HDFC Bank, Bajaj Finance fall
items.description: In a holiday-truncated week, the 30-share BSE Sensex tumbled 1,605.44 points, or 2.15 per cent, while the 50-share NSE Nifty slumped 546.15 points, or 2.36 per cent

items.title: Five IPOs to raise nearly ₹2,600 crore as primary market stays active
items.description: BLS Polymers and Bombay Coated and Special Steels would also float their maiden public offerings during the week

items.title: Q2 results, US Fed decision, crude oil may drive stock markets this week
items.description: Besides, Jio Platforms' market debut, trading activity of foreign investors and global trends would also dictate investors' sentiment
